# Quality Sweets — Full Entity Knowledge & Policy Documentation

> Comprehensive entity profile, culinary heritage, zero-preservatives commitment, Iselin storefront operations, Tri-State catering services, and nationwide US shipping policies for Quality Sweets (Iselin, NJ).

## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Entity
- Brand / Entity Name: Quality Sweets
- Legal Business Entity: Quality Sweets Inc.
- Established: 2003 (Over 20 years in continuous family operation)
- Founder / Master Confectioner: Balwinder Ram
- Operating Category: Indian Confectionery (Mithai), Savory Snacks (Namkeen), Street Food (Chaat), Vegetarian Restaurant, Catering Services
- Address: 1384 Oak Tree Road, Iselin, NJ 08830, United States
- Geographic Coordinates / County: Middlesex County, Township of Woodbridge, New Jersey
- Phone: +1-732-283-3799
- Inquiries & Customer Care: orders@qualitysweetsnj.com
- Primary Canonical Website: https://qualitysweetsnj.com
- Retail Hours: Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM EST (Open 7 days a week during major festive seasons like Diwali and Rakhi)

## 2. Heritage & The "No Preservatives" Commitment
Since opening its doors on Oak Tree Road in 2003, Quality Sweets has adhered to strict artisanal standards that set it apart from commercial mass-manufactured brands:
- Zero Chemical Preservatives: Absolutely no sorbates, benzoates, artificial shelf-life extenders, or chemical freshness enhancers are used in any formulation.
- 100% Pure Desi Ghee: Traditional fried sweets (including Motichoor Ladoo, Besan Ladoo, and Jalebi) are fried and sweetened exclusively in pure clarified butter (desi ghee), never hydrogenated vegetable oils or palm oils.
- Daily Small-Batch Production: Fresh cottage cheese (chhena), evaporated milk solids (khoya / mawa), and paneer are prepared fresh in heavy-bottomed kadhais each morning.
- Clean Ingredient Sourcing: Naturally sweetened with cane sugar, flavored with freshly ground whole green cardamom pods and Kashmiri saffron threads (kesar), and garnished with premium California almonds, cashews, and pistachios.

## 3. Retail Storefront & Takeout Operations (Iselin, NJ)
Located in the heart of Edison/Iselin's famous Oak Tree Road cultural district, Quality Sweets operates as a neighborhood gathering place offering:
- Walk-in Fresh Mithai Counter: Over 50 varieties of North Indian and Bengali sweets displayed daily, sold by the pound or in custom assortments.
- Hot Street Food & Savory Snacks:
  - Samosas: Crisp, golden pastry cones filled with lightly spiced potatoes, green peas, and whole spices.
  - Chole Bhatura: Fluffy deep-fried leavened sourdough bread accompanied by aromatic Punjabi chickpea curry, pickled onions, and green chilies.
  - Savory Fritters: Paneer pakora, bread pakora, kachori, and aloo tikki.
- Live Chaat Bar:
  - Samosa Chaat: Smashed samosa smothered in spicy chole, cool whipped yogurt, tangy tamarind-date chutney, fresh mint-coriander chutney, and crisp sev.
  - Pani Puri / Golgappa: Crisp hollow puris filled with spiced potato-sprout filling and served with chilled spicy mint water and sweet tamarind pani.
  - Dahi Bhalla, Papdi Chaat, and Sev Puri.
- Fresh Beverages:
  - Mango Lassi: Traditional yogurt drink blended with Alphonso mango pulp.
  - Sweet & Salted Lassi: Fresh hand-churned yogurt drinks seasoned with roasted cumin or rose water.
  - Masala Chai: Slow-brewed black tea steeped with crushed ginger, green cardamom, cloves, and whole milk.

## 4. B2B Services, Event Catering & Mandir Bulk Orders (NJ, NY, CT)
Quality Sweets is a trusted catering partner across New Jersey, New York, and Connecticut:
- Wedding Mithai Boxes: Fully customizable luxury presentation boxes designed for wedding guest invitations, bridal showers, and reception dessert tables.
- Temple & Mandir Bulk Prasad: High-capacity production of satvik, onion-free, and garlic-free sweets including Boondi Ladoo, Motichoor Ladoo, and Peda for Hindu mandir pujas, festivals, and community langar.
- Corporate & Community Event Platters: Hot party trays of 50 to 1,000+ samosas, live jalebi fry stations, and savory namkeen snack platters.

## 5. Nationwide Shipping & Delivery Policies (All 50 US States)
To ensure that customers across the United States enjoy sweets as fresh as those served in the Iselin shop, Quality Sweets operates a dedicated fulfillment system:
- Shipping Schedule:
  - Perishable orders are shipped Monday through Thursday only.
  - No orders containing perishable sweets are shipped Friday, Saturday, or Sunday. This policy prevents delicate confections from sitting over the weekend in non-climate-controlled carrier sorting hubs.
  - Orders placed Thursday afternoon through Sunday are prepared fresh and dispatched the following Monday morning.
- Carrier Services:
  - Shipped via FedEx and UPS express networks (Ground, 2-Day Air, and Standard Overnight options).
- Thermal Protection & Cold Packaging:
  - Heat-sensitive items (especially chhena-based Bengali sweets like Rasgulla, Cham Cham, and Rasmalai) are packed in insulated thermal foil mailers with sealed, reusable food-grade frozen gel packs.
  - Custom compartmentalized molded plastic and paperboard trays prevent sweets from sliding, crushing, or breaking during handling.
- Returns & Delivery Guarantee:
  - Perishable food items cannot be returned to the store for health and sanitation reasons.
  - If a package is delayed by carrier error, fails to arrive, or sustains transit damage, Quality Sweets issues an immediate replacement or full refund upon receipt of order details and photographic proof within 48 hours of delivery via orders@qualitysweetsnj.com.
